name: EM FX Carry-to-Vol Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR — DXY Regime Filter
description: Monthly cross-sectional carry-to-vol ranking of USDBRL, USDMXN, USDZAR, split by DXY regime (USD weakening vs strengthening). Carry = (EM rate - USD rate) / 100 / 12. Vol = 30-day realized vol (annualized). Ranks currencies 1–3 each month (rank 1 = best carry-to-vol). DXY regime = sign of 1-month log change in Broad Trade-Weighted Dollar Index (DTWEXBGS). Outputs: regime-split summary table (avg return / hit rate by rank × regime), per-currency grouped bars (rank-1 return: weak vs strong USD), cumulative L/S strategy with regime-conditional overlays, and carry-to-vol time series.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM FX CARRY-TO-VOL RANKING: BRL, MXN, ZAR
# =============================================================================
# Monthly cross-sectional ranking of 3 EM currencies by carry-to-vol ratio.
# Carry = (EM central bank rate - USD Fed Funds) / 100 / 12 (monthly yield diff)
# Vol   = 30-day rolling realized vol of daily log returns, annualized
# Rank  = 1 (best carry-to-vol) to 3 (worst) each month
# Forward return = next-month EM appreciation vs USD (negative USDFX log return)
#
# FRED series used:
#   BRL: IRSTCI01BRM156N  (Brazil short-term rate, monthly, annualized %)
#   MXN: IRSTCI01MXM156N  (Mexico short-term rate, monthly, annualized %)
#   ZAR: IRSTCI01ZAM156N  (South Africa short-term rate, monthly, annualized %)
#   USD: FEDFUNDS          (Fed Funds rate, monthly, annualized %)
# =============================================================================

# --- Daily FX data (USDBRL, USDMXN, USDZAR) ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CENTRAL BANK RATES (FRED) — ffill to daily, then downsample to monthly
# =============================================================================

# EM rates (monthly series, annualized %)
brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="IRSTCI01BRM156N", use_alfred=False)()
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="IRSTCI01MXM156N", use_alfred=False)()
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="IRSTCI01ZAM156N", use_alfred=False)()

# USD rate (monthly, annualized %)
usd_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="FEDFUNDS", use_alfred=False)()

# Forward-fill to daily frequency so every trading day has a rate
brl_rate_daily = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)
mxn_rate_daily = ffill(mxn_rate_raw.result)
zar_rate_daily = ffill(zar_rate_raw.result)
usd_rate_daily = ffill(usd_rate_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# DAILY LOG RETURNS & 30-DAY REALIZED VOL (annualized)
# =============================================================================

# Daily log returns of USDFX pairs
log_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(close)

# 30-day rolling std of log returns × sqrt(252) = annualized realized vol
vol_30d = stddev(period=30)(log_ret) * sqrt(252.0)

# =============================================================================
# DOWNSAMPLE TO MONTHLY (end-of-month values)
# =============================================================================

# End-of-month FX close price
close_monthly = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(close)

# End-of-month vol (last daily vol reading of the month)
vol_monthly = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(vol_30d)

# End-of-month rates
brl_rate_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(brl_rate_daily)
mxn_rate_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(mxn_rate_daily)
zar_rate_m = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(zar_rate_daily)
usd_rate_m  = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(usd_rate_daily)

# =============================================================================
# MONTHLY CARRY (per-currency yield differential over USD)
# =============================================================================
# carry = (EM_rate - USD_rate) / 100 / 12
# Positive = EM currency earns more than USD on a 1-month basis
# Each FX pair asset sees its own EM rate via is_asset_ref routing

is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDBRL")()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDMXN")()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDZAR")()

em_rate_m = conditional_select(
    is_brl, brl_rate_m,
    is_mxn, mxn_rate_m,
    is_zar, zar_rate_m,
    brl_rate_m
)

carry_monthly = (em_rate_m - usd_rate_m) / 100.0 / 12.0

# =============================================================================
# CARRY-TO-VOL RATIO (monthly)
# =============================================================================

carry_to_vol = carry_monthly / vol_monthly

# =============================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL RANK (monthly)
# Rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol (best), Rank 3 = lowest (worst)
# =============================================================================

rank = cs_rank(ascending=False)(carry_to_vol)

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD MONTHLY RETURN (EM appreciation vs USD)
# forward_returns(period=1, log) on USDFX = log(next_close / this_close)
# Negate: falling USDFX = EM appreciating → positive EM return
# =============================================================================

fwd_ret_usd_fx = forward_returns(period=1, return_type=ReturnType.log)(close_monthly)
fwd_ret_em = -1.0 * fwd_ret_usd_fx

# =============================================================================
# RANK-FILTERED RETURN SERIES
# Each series is non-null only when this currency held that rank
# =============================================================================

rank1_ret = where(rank == 1.0, fwd_ret_em)
rank2_ret = where(rank == 2.0, fwd_ret_em)
rank3_ret = where(rank == 3.0, fwd_ret_em)

# Hit rate helpers: 1.0 when rank=N AND return positive, else 0.0 (null outside rank)
rank1_hit = where(rank == 1.0, 1.0 if fwd_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)
rank2_hit = where(rank == 2.0, 1.0 if fwd_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)
rank3_hit = where(rank == 3.0, 1.0 if fwd_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)

# Expanding Sharpe per rank (mean / std of returns when at that rank)
rank1_sharpe = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(rank1_ret) / cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(rank1_ret)
rank2_sharpe = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(rank2_ret) / cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(rank2_ret)
rank3_sharpe = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(rank3_ret) / cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(rank3_ret)

# =============================================================================
# UNIVERSE-LEVEL AGGREGATIONS (cs_agg)
# At each month, exactly one asset has rank=1 (others null) → Sum = that asset's return
# =============================================================================

rank1_universe_ret = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum)(rank1_ret)
rank3_universe_ret = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum)(rank3_ret)

# Long-short monthly return: long rank-1 / short rank-3
ls_monthly_ret = rank1_universe_ret - rank3_universe_ret

# Cumulative returns for strategy chart
cum_rank1 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(rank1_universe_ret)
cum_rank3 = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(rank3_universe_ret)
cum_ls    = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(ls_monthly_ret)

# =============================================================================
# DXY REGIME FILTER
# Broad Trade-Weighted Dollar Index (DTWEXBGS) from FRED — daily, 2006+
# =============================================================================

dxy_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="DTWEXBGS", use_alfred=False)()

# Forward-fill to daily, then downsample to monthly end-of-month
dxy_daily = ffill(dxy_raw.result)
dxy_monthly = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(dxy_daily)

# 1-month log return of DXY: positive = USD strengthening, negative = USD weakening
dxy_mom = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(dxy_monthly)

# Regime booleans (determined at month-end t, applied to next-month return at t+1)
is_weak_usd   = dxy_mom < 0.0    # USD weakening: EM carry tends to outperform
is_strong_usd = dxy_mom >= 0.0   # USD strengthening: EM carry tends to underperform

# =============================================================================
# REGIME-SPLIT RETURN SERIES
# rank1/rank3 returns filtered by DXY regime at the same month-end
# =============================================================================

# Rank-1 returns by regime
rank1_ret_weak   = where(is_weak_usd   and rank == 1.0, fwd_ret_em)
rank1_ret_strong = where(is_strong_usd and rank == 1.0, fwd_ret_em)

# Rank-3 returns by regime
rank3_ret_weak   = where(is_weak_usd   and rank == 3.0, fwd_ret_em)
rank3_ret_strong = where(is_strong_usd and rank == 3.0, fwd_ret_em)

# Hit rate helpers for rank-1 by regime (1.0 when positive return, else 0.0)
rank1_hit_weak   = where(is_weak_usd   and rank == 1.0, 1.0 if fwd_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)
rank1_hit_strong = where(is_strong_usd and rank == 1.0, 1.0 if fwd_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# REGIME-CONDITIONAL UNIVERSE L/S RETURNS (for cumulative chart)
# At each month, exactly one asset has rank=1 (others null) → Sum = that asset's return
# Zero out L/S return in the opposite regime to isolate regime contribution
# =============================================================================

rank1_universe_ret_weak   = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum)(rank1_ret_weak)
rank3_universe_ret_weak   = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum)(rank3_ret_weak)
rank1_universe_ret_strong = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum)(rank1_ret_strong)
rank3_universe_ret_strong = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum)(rank3_ret_strong)

# Regime-conditional L/S monthly returns (0 in the opposite regime)
ls_weak_monthly   = rank1_universe_ret_weak   - rank3_universe_ret_weak
ls_strong_monthly = rank1_universe_ret_strong - rank3_universe_ret_strong

# Cumulative regime-conditional L/S (coalesce nulls to 0 so cumsum is continuous)
cum_ls_weak   = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(coalesce(ls_weak_monthly,   0.0))
cum_ls_strong = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(coalesce(ls_strong_monthly, 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: CROSS-SECTIONAL SUMMARY TABLE — Regime-Split Rank Performance
# Rows = currencies, Cols = avg return / hit rate for rank 1 & 3 by DXY regime
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title='EM FX Carry-to-Vol Rank Performance by DXY Regime',
    category='Carry-to-Vol Ranking',
    order=0,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='EM FX Carry-to-Vol Rank Performance by DXY Regime',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Ret Rank1 (Weak USD)',   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Ret Rank1 (Strong USD)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Ret Rank3 (Weak USD)',   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Ret Rank3 (Strong USD)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate Rank1 (Weak USD)',  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate Rank1 (Strong USD)',type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    )
)(rank1_ret_weak, rank1_ret_strong, rank3_ret_weak, rank3_ret_strong, rank1_hit_weak, rank1_hit_strong)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: XY BARS — Rank-1 avg return per currency, grouped by DXY regime
# X-axis categories = currencies (BRL, MXN, ZAR via stack)
# Series = Weak USD (Blue) vs Strong USD (Indigo)
# 6 inputs: [BRL_weak, MXN_weak, ZAR_weak, BRL_strong, MXN_strong, ZAR_strong]
# =============================================================================

# Per-currency rank-1 returns filtered by regime (is_asset_ref routing)
brl_rank1_weak   = where(is_brl and is_weak_usd   and rank == 1.0, fwd_ret_em)
mxn_rank1_weak   = where(is_mxn and is_weak_usd   and rank == 1.0, fwd_ret_em)
zar_rank1_weak   = where(is_zar and is_weak_usd   and rank == 1.0, fwd_ret_em)
brl_rank1_strong = where(is_brl and is_strong_usd and rank == 1.0, fwd_ret_em)
mxn_rank1_strong = where(is_mxn and is_strong_usd and rank == 1.0, fwd_ret_em)
zar_rank1_strong = where(is_zar and is_strong_usd and rank == 1.0, fwd_ret_em)

xy_bars(
    title='Rank-1 Avg Next-Month EM Return by Currency and DXY Regime',
    category='Carry-to-Vol Ranking',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Avg Next-Month Return (Rank 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Weak USD',   color=Color.Blue,   stack='BRL'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Strong USD', color=Color.Indigo, stack='BRL'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Weak USD',   color=Color.Blue,   stack='MXN'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Strong USD', color=Color.Indigo, stack='MXN'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Weak USD',   color=Color.Blue,   stack='ZAR'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Strong USD', color=Color.Indigo, stack='ZAR')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(brl_rank1_weak, brl_rank1_strong, mxn_rank1_weak, mxn_rank1_strong, zar_rank1_weak, zar_rank1_strong)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: XY LINES — cumulative returns with regime-conditional overlays
# Full L/S + Weak-USD-only L/S + Strong-USD-only L/S
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative L/S Strategy Returns: Full vs DXY Regime Contribution',
    category='Carry-to-Vol Strategy',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Log Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    area=False,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Long Rank-1 (Best C/V)',          color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Short Rank-3 (Worst C/V)',        color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='L/S Full Strategy',               color=Color.Emerald,  dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='L/S — Weak USD Months Only',      color=Color.Sky,      dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='L/S — Strong USD Months Only',    color=Color.Orange,   dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_idx, cum_rank1, cum_rank3, cum_ls, cum_ls_weak, cum_ls_strong)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: CS LINES — carry-to-vol ratio over time for all 3 currencies
# =============================================================================

cs_lines(
    title='Monthly Carry-to-Vol Ratio Over Time',
    category='Carry-to-Vol Ranking',
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    order=3
)(bar_idx, carry_to_vol)
